findings.entry_point: <Name>_hash_tree_root(h, o) of every name holding O.Words or O.Bits

findings.entry_point: <Name>_decode(buf, size)

findings.call_chain: X_append -> app_c -> grow -> O.words_fit (roomy: array kept) -> O.words_write at byte n (merge_word writes only the element's bytes); bits: push of bit 31 makes the next (spare, non-zero) word the delimiter word
findings.why: _valid admits non-zero spare storage (docs/API_CONTRACTS.md: the root of a valid object is the spec root whatever spare storage it has, CH-11 / R2-02 (b)); the append turns spare bytes into bytes of the last word past the new length, which words_ok / bits_ok require to be zero. The append answers ok, the root is right (clean copy), only the later _serialize refuses a value the spec encodes
findings.fix: clear the spare part of the word in the roomy branch of the append (write the element with the mask covering the bytes above it when it starts a word; zero word (k + 1) >> 5 when a bit-list push fills bit 31), or take the copying branch (grow_to copies ceil(n/4) words into zero storage) when the word past the data is not zero
findings.proof_impact: none semantically for represented objects (zero over zero, words_canon.bend); the append writer text and the regenerated per-kind append laws change
findings.status: FIXED (crash-fix6): the byte append merges into O.app_old (zero when the element starts its word), the bit push closes the next word (O.bits_close: zero after bit 31 of a word); regress.sh cases 67-70
